title: Shared Confession (first full final marriage scene)

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The conversation winds down to the sound of the fountain. Nobody rushes to fill the quiet.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I did prepare one. It might be a mistake.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “A speech? For me? Is there a handout?”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “It has a beginning, three key points and a conclusion.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You unfold the paper. Every tidy sentence on it looks like somewhere to hide.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Actually… I don’t want to read it.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Take your time. Skip the clever bits. I’ve got plenty coming out of my ears.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I came here trying to become someone who could win a princess.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “You kept showing me I didn’t need a perfect line to care about someone.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “And you showed me someone can stay after the last joke.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her tail flicks once. Then she waits.

options.labelText: “I love your clever lines, and the moments you run out of them. Will you marry me, and work out the rest as equals?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “You didn’t promise I’d never be frightened again.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “That’s my whole speech. One point. No conclusion.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Your prepared speech slips off the edge of the fountain. Nobody fishes it out.

options.labelText: “Marry me, and I’ll make sure you’re always everyone’s favorite princess. Nobody will ever be disappointed in you.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Then listen. I don’t want to be a flawless princess in your care. I want to be a person beside you.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She doesn’t walk away. She doesn’t say yes, either.

options.labelText: “Say yes and we’ll be the funniest royal couple in history. Imagine the applause.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “I can imagine it. I can also imagine us as strangers the minute the curtain falls.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Ask me because you want a life with me. Not a double act.”
